data.notes: August 2026 is unusually festival-heavy around Los Angeles, with electronic, K-pop, indie, hardcore and Hollywood Bowl summer programming all clustering in the same month.

events.title: HARD Summer Music Festival 2026
events.summary: HARD Summer returns to Hollywood Park in Inglewood for a two-day electronic festival. The announced 2026 lineup includes Kali Uchis, Knock2 B2B Zedd, DJ Snake, Tokischa, Shygirl presents Club Shy, Charlotte de Witte, Amelie Lens, Mau P, RL Grime and more.

events.title: KCON LA 2026
events.venueName: Crypto.com Arena and Los Angeles Convention Center
events.summary: KCON LA returns downtown with K-pop performances and fan programming at Crypto.com Arena and the Los Angeles Convention Center. Reported headliners include NCT 127, TOMORROW X TOGETHER and ZEROBASEONE.

events.title: Just Like Heaven 2026
events.venueName: Brookside at the Rose Bowl Stadium
events.summary: Goldenvoice’s Just Like Heaven returns to Brookside at the Rose Bowl for a single-day indie and electro-dance festival. The lineup includes The Strokes, LCD Soundsystem, TV Girl, Chromeo, The Rapture, Feist, Twin Peaks, Matt and Kim, Dayglow and more.

events.title: Ed Sheeran: LOOP Tour
events.summary: Ed Sheeran brings his LOOP Tour to SoFi Stadium in Inglewood. The venue listing names Myles Smith, Sigrid and Aaron Rowe as supporting artists.

events.title: Celebrating Gustavo at the Bowl: Foo Fighters with the LA Phil and YOLA
events.summary: Foo Fighters join the Los Angeles Philharmonic and Youth Orchestra Los Angeles for a one-night Celebrating Gustavo at the Bowl performance. The LA Phil announcement lists the show for Saturday, August 22 at 8 PM.

events.title: Head In The Clouds Los Angeles 2026
events.summary: 88rising and Goldenvoice’s Head In The Clouds returns as a one-day Pasadena festival. The listed lineup includes KATSEYE, XG, Rich Brian, UMI, Warren Hue, KiiiKiii, DaBin, Gia Fu and more.

events.title: Noah Kahan: The Great Divide Tour
events.summary: Noah Kahan brings The Great Divide Tour to the Rose Bowl in Pasadena. Ticketmaster lists the stadium show for Saturday, August 15 at 6:30 PM.

events.title: Sound and Fury Festival 2026
events.summary: Sound and Fury returns to Exposition Park for two days of hardcore, punk, metal and adjacent underground music. The official announcement lists Angel Du$t, Obituary, Incendiary, Saves The Day, Sextile, Koyo, Merauder and more.

events.title: RÜFÜS DU SOL: North America 2026
events.summary: Australian electronic trio RÜFÜS DU SOL plays Kia Forum in Inglewood on its North America 2026 tour. The event is listed by Ticketmaster for 7:30 PM.

events.title: Framework presents Carlita
events.summary: Framework closes the August portion of its Gin Ling Way Summer 2026 outdoor series with Carlita, supported by KinAhau and Minus The Light, in the Chinatown corridor.

events.title: Day Trip in the Park LA: Loco Dice, Archie Hamilton
events.summary: Day Trip’s LA State Historic Park Sunday series closes August with a larger house-focused bill led by Loco Dice and Archie Hamilton.

events.title: Herbie Hancock Celebrates Miles Davis
events.summary: Herbie Hancock leads a Hollywood Bowl celebration of Miles Davis’ centennial. The LA Phil announcement lists the concert for Wednesday, August 19 at 8 PM.

events.title: Al Green · The Womack Sisters
events.summary: Soul legend Al Green headlines the Hollywood Bowl, with The Womack Sisters opening. The LA Phil season announcement lists the concert for Friday, August 14 at 8 PM.

events.title: Midnight Lovers with Azzecca, Afriqua, Ray Kash
events.summary: Midnight Lovers runs a day-into-night open-air Terrace affair at The Bridge with Azzecca on an extended set, Afriqua, and Ray Kash, plus food and vendors.

events.title: Framework presents Rossi.
events.summary: Framework’s Summer 2026 outdoor series lands at Expo Lawn with UK house selector Rossi. and JAMBACK, part of the promoter’s citywide run of house and techno events.

events.title: St. Vincent with the Hollywood Bowl Orchestra
events.summary: St. Vincent performs with the Hollywood Bowl Orchestra as part of the Bowl’s 2026 summer season. Anoushka Shankar is listed as the opener for the KCRW Festival night.

events.title: Day Trip in the Park LA: CID, ToBeHonest, Juos, Cat & Maomi
events.summary: Insomniac’s Day Trip in the Park LA series continues its Sunday open-air house format at LA State Historic Park with CID, ToBeHonest, Juos, Cat & Maomi.

events.title: Day Trip in the Park LA: Discip, Adam Sellouk, Gabss, Welker
events.summary: Day Trip in the Park LA returns for another Sunday house session at LA State Historic Park with Discip, Adam Sellouk, Gabss, and Welker.

events.title: Maccabi House LA feat. Adam Ten x Mita Gami
events.summary: Stranger Than stages the third edition of Maccabi House LA as an open-air Yaanga Park day-into-night session headlined by Adam Ten x Mita Gami, with Jørd, Mary Jane, and The Botanist.

events.title: BAILE WORLD ft DJ Slugo
events.summary: BAILE WORLD brings Chicago ghetto-house/juke veteran DJ Slugo to a secret DTLA late-night room as part of his Longevity Tour, with a fuller lineup still to be announced.
